basis: Duodenal atresia and tetralogy of Fallot define gastrointestinal and cardiac malformations.
Benign tumour arising in the rete ovarii; reproductive tissue has no axis.
Acute leukemia is a malignancy of blood-forming cells; X-linked inheritance adds no organ axis.
Alpha-globin synthesis disorder; cardiac failure and effusions reflect severe subtypes, not most patients across this spectrum; hepatomegaly alone is insufficient.
Progressive dystonia defines neurologic disease caused by an inherited mitochondrial oxidative phosphorylation disorder.
Bone fragility, fractures and skeletal deformity define CRTAP-related osteogenesis imperfecta; blue sclerae alone do not establish ocular dysfunction.
Neurodevelopmental impairment, distal contractures and pituitary/hypogonadal dysfunction define the syndrome; feeding difficulty does not establish intrinsic gut damage.
Chronic immune-complex cutaneous small-vessel vasculitis; arthralgia alone does not establish joint damage.
Defective luteinizing hormone causes endocrine gonadal dysfunction and abnormal sexual differentiation.
Disease of skeletal ligaments, which belong to the locomotor connective tissues.
Congenital ureteral dilatation with reflux; ureters are included in the renal axis.
Cerebral visual-processing deficit causing impaired recognition of whole scenes; no intrinsic eye disorder is established.
Paralysis of pupillary and accommodation function involving the internal ocular muscles and their oculomotor parasympathetic innervation.
Definition includes skeletal dysplasia, hypoparathyroidism with hypocalcemia, and characteristic structural or refractive eye abnormalities.
Pathologic ectasia of gastric antral vessels; associated liver, renal and autoimmune diseases are separate conditions.
Bardet-Biedl/Joubert subtype spectrum supports neurologic involvement; supplied evidence does not establish common retinal, renal or skeletal damage across the umbrella.
Inherited syndrome defined by magnesium and lipid abnormalities plus hypertension; renal damage is not established by hypomagnesemia alone.
DIAPH1-related sensorineural hearing loss; intrinsic macrothrombocytopenia occurs in 8/8 annotated patients despite the historical nonsyndromic label.
Neutropenia, marrow fibrosis, immunodeficiency and nephromegaly define VPS45 deficiency; hepatomegaly alone does not establish liver injury, nor diarrhea intrinsic gut damage.
Pathologic destruction of internal tooth hard tissue; teeth belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
KAT6B disorders feature developmental disability and skeletal/patellar abnormalities; congenital cardiac malformations occur in roughly half.
Premature cranial suture fusion defines a skull disorder; supplied strabismus annotation lacks frequency sufficient to establish common ocular involvement.
Cardiac enlargement and remodeling caused by chronic hypertension define the disease.
Complement-mediated hemolysis, thrombocytopenia and renal injury; direct microvascular endothelial injury and thrombosis are defining, present in essentially all.
Carcinoma originates in the gastric cardia epithelium; no additional organ involvement is intrinsic to this site-defined concept.
